title: About Our Company
content: TechCorp Solutions is a leading technology company founded in 2015, specializing in AI-powered software products and enterprise solutions. We serve over 5,000 clients worldwide across 30+ countries.

title: Working Hours
content: Our company working hours are 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Friday (IST). We are closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays. Our 24/7 automated support portal is always available at support.techcorp.com.

title: Refund Policy
content: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are evaluated on a case-by-case basis. To request a refund, email refunds@techcorp.com with your order number. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UPI, Net Banking, PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption. EMI options are available on purchases above ₹10,000 through select banks.

title: Contact Information
content: You can reach us at: Email: support@techcorp.com | Phone: +91-80-4567-8900 | WhatsApp: +91-98765-43210 | Live Chat: Available on our website during business hours. Our support team responds within 4 hours on business days.

title: Office Location
content: Our headquarters is located at TechCorp Tower, 4th Floor, MG Road, Bangalore, Karnataka - 560001, India. We also have regional offices in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, and Hyderabad. International offices in Singapore and Dubai.

title: Products and Services
content: TechCorp offers: (1) TechCorp CRM - Customer relationship management platform, (2) TechCorp Analytics - Business intelligence and data analytics suite, (3) TechCorp Automate - Workflow automation tool, (4) TechCorp AI Assistant - Multilingual AI chatbot solution, (5) Custom enterprise software development.

title: Pricing Plans
content: Our pricing plans: Starter Plan - ₹999/month (up to 5 users), Professional Plan - ₹2,999/month (up to 25 users), Enterprise Plan - ₹9,999/month (unlimited users). Annual subscriptions get 20% discount. Free 14-day trial available for all plans. No credit card required for trial.

title: Cancellation Policy
content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account dashboard. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle. You retain access to all features until the billing period ends. We do not charge cancellation fees. To cancel, go to Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan.

title: Delivery and Onboarding Timeline
content: SaaS products are available immediately after payment. Custom software projects: initial delivery within 4-8 weeks depending on scope. Onboarding assistance is provided free of charge for Professional and Enterprise plans. Starter plan users can access our self-serve onboarding guides.

title: Customer Support Options
content: Starter Plan: Email support (24-48 hour response time). Professional Plan: Priority email + live chat support (4-hour response time). Enterprise Plan: Dedicated account manager + phone support + 2-hour SLA. All plans include access to our knowledge base, video tutorials, and community forum.

title: Security and Compliance
content: TechCorp is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. We are also SOC 2 Type II certified. Data is stored in AWS data centers located in Mumbai (primary) and Singapore (backup). All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We conduct quarterly security audits.

title: Free Trial
content: All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start the trial. You get full access to all features of your chosen plan during the trial. At the end of 14 days, you can choose to subscribe or your account will be automatically paused. No charges are made without your explicit consent.

title: Integrations and Compatibility
content: TechCorp integrates with: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, Jira, Trello, GitHub, and 100+ other tools via our REST API. We provide official SDKs for Python, JavaScript, Java, and PHP. Webhooks are supported on Professional and Enterprise plans.

title: Data Export and Portability
content: You can export all your data at any time in CSV, JSON, or Excel formats. Data export is available from your account Settings > Data Management > Export. Enterprise customers can request automated data exports via API. We guarantee data portability and will assist with migration if you decide to leave.
